It is incredibly compassionate of you to want to support your mother. Based on what you've described, she may be dealing with chronic depression alongside severe anxiety or agoraphobia, which can make leaving the house and socializing feel genuinely overwhelming. While you cannot diagnose or cure her, your presence alone is a comfort. You can help by offering a listening ear without judgment and gently encouraging her to speak with a doctor or mental health professional. Offering to help her find a therapist who does telehealth appointments might remove the scary barrier of having to go outside. 

You can also support her by spending low-pressure time together at home, like watching a movie or sharing a meal. Please remember that supporting a parent with long-term mental health struggles can be heavy, so it is just as important to set boundaries and seek support for yourself. You don't have to carry this alone.
